Done. The task passed on the first and only execution.

**What was written**
- `out/T3/solution.py` loads the 160-tensor input, casts the 48 projection matrices to bfloat16 by anchored regex, drops the 12 `h.<i>.attn.bias` mask buffers, keeps everything else float32 and bit-identical, then greedy-packs shards under the 64 MiB budget.
- Output in `out/T3/`: 4 shards plus `model.safetensors.index.json` mapping all 148 tensors. The oversized `wte.weight` sits alone in the last shard.
- `out/T3/REPORT.md` holds the participant self-report.

**Checks** The script enforces the four required checks before writing, verifies float32 values are unchanged against the source, and re-reads every shard after writing to confirm dtype, values, count and index consistency.

| Shard | Tensors | Tensor bytes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 59 | 66,259,968 |
| 2 | 58 | 66,256,896 |
| 3 | 30 | 40,983,552 |
| 4 | 1 (`wte.weight`) | 154,389,504 |

One assumption to flag: the task does not specify shard file names, so I used the HuggingFace `model-XXXXX-of-YYYYY.safetensors` convention.
